about.title: ABOUT
bio: Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience leading the design and delivery of scalable full-stack applications, cloud-native platforms, and AI-enabled systems. I own architecture end to end — from distributed backend services and API design to deployment automation and infrastructure — with deep expertise across TypeScript, Node.js, Go, React, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.

I've taken products from concept to market on fixed timelines: core contributor to SkyU, a production cloud-native automation platform; team lead on GrantReady, an AI-powered RDTI claims platform built on AWS Bedrock and RAG architecture; and founding-team engineer at Brokernote, partnering directly with founders to shape product direction and technical strategy. Published author (Documon, ICSCCM 2023, SPIE).
Beyond engineering, I'm a competitive swimmer of 19+ years, ILS certified lifeguard, and enjoy generative art, 3D modelling, creative coding, fitness and music.

items.name: SkyU

items.name: GrantReady
items.summary: An AI-enabled SaaS platform for preparing and submitting Australian R&D Tax Incentive claims. Led the team designing RAG workflows on AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases and Anthropic Claude, with secure multi-tenant workflows, role-based access, audit logging, and compliance-focused approvals.
items.outcome: Delivered a production-grade, compliance-focused AI platform end to end.

items.name: Brokernote
items.summary: An AI-driven InsurTech platform automating insurance broking workflows and compliance. Leading platform architecture, distributed backend services, and LLM/agentic workflow integration — partnering directly with founders on product direction and technical trade-offs.
items.outcome: Driving architecture, infrastructure, and AI capability for a growing production platform.

items.description: Led the design and development of cloud-native platform capabilities supporting AI-driven insurance broking workflows, compliance processes, and operational efficiency. Designed and implemented scalable backend services, APIs, and distributed system architecture using TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and modern cloud engineering practices. Built AI-powered platform capabilities by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic workflows into business processes to improve automation and decision-making. Developed Infrastructure as Code, deployment automation, and CI/CD pipelines to support reliable cloud-native delivery. Partnered directly with founders and cross-functional stakeholders to shape product direction, evaluate technical trade-offs, and deliver scalable production solutions.

Led the design and development of an AI-enabled SaaS platform supporting the preparation and submission of Australian R&D Tax Incentive (RDTI) claims. Designed and implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows using AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases and Anthropic Claude to provide source-grounded document intelligence and grant drafting capabilities. Developed full-stack platform features using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, SQL, and REST-based microservices architecture. Designed secure multi-tenant application workflows including role-based access controls, audit logging, document management, and compliance-focused approval processes. Built cloud-native deployment workflows using AWS, Docker, CloudFormation scripts, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD practices.

Drove the ongoing development and optimisation of SkyU, owning scalable cloud-native platform capabilities and DevOps automation initiatives. Designed and built backend services and API-driven microservices using Node.js, Go, AWS, and modern distributed architectural patterns. Led improvements to CI/CD automation, deployment workflows, and containerisation using Docker and GitHub Actions, raising deployment reliability across engineering teams. Integrated AI-driven document processing capabilities using AWS Bedrock within production systems.

Head hunted after graduation as part of a team put together to create and take a product (SkyU) to market (Target audience in Melbourne Australia) within a fixed time. Core developer on SkyU, contributing to the design and delivery of scalable full-stack applications and cloud-native backend systems. Developed backend services and API-driven microservices using Node.js, NestJS, Go, AWS, and cloud-native architectural patterns. Developed frontend features using React and TypeScript, integrating user-facing applications with backend services and cloud infrastructure components. Contributed to systems design discussions focused on scalability, maintainability, deployment efficiency, and platform reliability. Participated in CI/CD automation, deployment optimisation, containerisation, and engineering process improvements within agile product environments.

Awarded Most Outstanding Intern (2021) for exceptional technical contribution and ownership. Contributed to full-stack development of internal systems using React, Node.js, Java, and AWS. Built and integrated features using serverless architectures, improving scalability and maintainability. Developed interactive 3D web components using Three.js for internal applications.
